title: Office of Strategic Capital Direct Loan to MP Materials
summary: The Office of Strategic Capital announced execution of a $150 million direct loan to add heavy rare-earth separation capability at MP Materials' existing Mountain Pass, California processing facility.
key_findings: The release describes the action as the Office of Strategic Capital's first executed direct loan.
The $150 million loan is assigned to heavy rare-earth separation at an existing U.S. processing site.
The release links the transaction to a wider July 2025 agreement with MP Materials.
why_it_matters: The record advances critical-minerals analysis from strategic intent into named financing, recipient, facility, process, and location evidence.
ftfn_relevance: Provides a specific critical-material processing action with an executed financial instrument.
Defines the next evidence gates as facility work, commissioning, qualification, and sustained output.
evidence_limits: An executed loan does not prove that the separation capability has been built, commissioned, or operated.
The release does not establish future capacity, output quality, feedstock, customers, economics, or repayment performance.
